# Core

The foundational layer for the Tiwut Web SDK.

## Files
- `css/reset.css`: Modern CSS reset to normalize browser defaults.
- `css/utilities.css`: Base utility classes (typography, spacing, responsive flex/grid) and structural blur/glassmorphism utilities that rely on theme variables.

## Usage
Include these files before any themes or components to ensure a consistent baseline.
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="path/to/core/css/reset.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="path/to/core/css/utilities.css">
```
